verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com returning HTTP 200 with a structured index of the Mesh guides. The docs pages themselves are served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at clean markdown docs. The 404 on the doubled '.md.md' path is a probe artifact, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific guidance content, the OpenAPI schema is not exposed at a standard machine-discoverable path, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
